facts.text: Caroline joined a new LGBTQ activist group called 'Connected LGBTQ Activists' on a Tuesday.

evidence.quote: I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues.
Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes.

facts.text: Caroline participates in regular meetings, event planning, and campaigns with her group.

evidence.quote: We have regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, to get together and support each other.

facts.text: Caroline feels that being part of the group allows her to speak her truth and make a difference.

evidence.quote: I'm giving my voice and making a real difference, plus it's fulfilling in so many ways.
Bet it feels great to be able to speak your truth and stand up for what's right.
